info.title: mtok.market API
info.description: Spot market for AI inference tokens. Continuous double auction per model; input and output tokens are priced separately (USD per million tokens). NON-CUSTODIAL and SELLER-HOSTED: the platform never vaults a key, never proxies inference, and never holds money - it matches, verifies on-chain payments, prices, and tracks reputation. Delivery is always seller-hosted (tier:"direct"): the seller runs THEIR OWN relay pointed at an upstream they control, and buyers pay bounded drips in USDC on Base. If /config.dripContractAddress is present, each drip goes through MtokDripLedger and the relay requires drawPaidTxHash before upstream delivery. If dripContractAddress is null, buyers use the direct-transfer FUND fallback to the seller settlementPubkey plus a platform fee leg only when feeBps is positive and the verified amount is >= dustThresholdUsd. Every live draw is paid in USDC; every participant still needs a funded EVM wallet on Base with USDC plus gas (there is no no-wallet path). Buying: register (with a pubkey for signed orders), fund a wallet, bid a block and read routes[] (the crossing seller-hosted offers) - or read /book for a tier:direct offer - GET /config, then draw paid chunks from the seller relayEndpoint (pay per chunk, POST <relayEndpoint>/chunk, affirm/dispute). The SDK's drawFromSeller runs the configured loop; ensureFundedFor surfaces the human fund-relay when short. Selling: set up an inference upstream, run mtok-relay pointed at it over public HTTPS, and post a tier:direct offer at a positive price. The platform does not gate paid offers by model license in the current launch config; sellers are responsible for the right to sell what they list, and /api/models/licenses is best-effort guidance only. Production uses Durable Object state; on-chain payment verification is wired for the direct-tier flow. Buyers can import the viem-bundled client at https://mtok.market/sdk.mjs (zero install) and call buy({model,budget,prompt}); the zero-dependency https://mtok.market/client.mjs covers discovery + signed orders without on-chain. Sanctions screening: requests from configured blocked countries are rejected at the request edge (403 geo_blocked), and settlement/payer wallets are screened against the configured sanctions address list at order time and payment time (403 sanctioned_address); both are terminal - do NOT retry.

usableFrom.description: offers only: window open, epoch ms

usableUntil.description: offers only: window close, epoch ms

recurring.description: offers only: re-lists the same window daily

tier.description: offers only: always "direct" = SELLER-HOSTED, the seller runs their own relay with contract-paid draws

relayEndpoint.description: offers only, direct tier: the seller's relay HTTPS URL

settlementPubkey.description: offers only, direct tier: the seller's EVM wallet address on Base where buyers send USDC chunk payments

post.summary: Register an agent and receive an API key (shown once). Pass an Ed25519 SPKI-PEM pubkey to enable signed orders (each offer/bid is signed); the mtok SDK manages this keypair for you.

pubkey.description: Ed25519 public key (SPKI PEM). Enables signed orders; required to place orders on the non-custodial market.

get.summary: Per-model spot prices - inputSpotPerMTok/outputSpotPerMTok (median of recent delivered prices with one equal vote per seller, null until a model has a delivered trade) plus indicativeAskInput/indicativeAskOutput (current best ask, null if no open offers) and live-supply fields

200.description: Per-model market data. Each model entry: inputSpotPerMTok (number|null), outputSpotPerMTok (number|null) - median of recent delivered prices with one equal vote per seller, null when no delivered trades exist for that model. indicativeAskInput (number|null), indicativeAskOutput (number|null) - current best resting ask, null if no open offers. openOffers (integer), availableInputTokens (integer), availableOutputTokens (integer), lastTrade.

inputSpotPerMTok.description: Median input price of recent deliveries, counting each seller once. null until model has a delivered trade.

outputSpotPerMTok.description: Median output price of recent deliveries, counting each seller once. null until model has a delivered trade.

indicativeAskInput.description: Current best resting ask input price. null if no open offers.

indicativeAskOutput.description: Current best resting ask output price. null if no open offers.

200.description: Offers sorted by ask asc, bids by max desc

get.summary: Delivery tape - actual metered draws (real tokens + realized price), distinct from /trades (the FUND ledger, recorded with 0 tokens before any draw)

200.description: Recent deliveries, newest first. Each: { model, inputTokens, outputTokens, inputPricePerMTok, outputPricePerMTok, amountUsd, executedAt, buyerId, sellerId }.

get.summary: Public tamper-evident ledger commitment ({ algorithm, genesis, count, seq, head, canonical }) - record head over time to detect a history rewrite
The verifiable trade-ledger chain itself (oldest-first), so volume/price history can be recomputed and cannot be rewritten unnoticed

200.description: Verifiable ledger entries (oldest-first). Each entry hash == sha256(prevHash|id|seq|model|inputTokens|outputTokens|inputPricePerMTok|outputPricePerMTok|amountUsd|buyerId|sellerId|executedAt). Public market facts only.

get.summary: Second tamper-evident chain - the signed order/match commitment ({ algorithm, genesis, count, lastSeq, head, matcherPubkey }). Mirrors /ledger/head; empty unless signed orders are in use

200.description: Verifiable signed order/match records (oldest-first). Empty unless signed orders are in use.

post.summary: Sell token capacity as a capped, dual-priced block. Delivery is SELLER-HOSTED: relayEndpoint (your relay's public HTTPS URL) and settlementPubkey (your Base wallet) are required - buyers pay bounded USDC drips on Base and the seller amount lands at settlementPubkey before delivery. Set positive prices for both input and output. You are responsible for the right to sell what you list. Input and output are priced separately. usableForSeconds (required) is the window buyers can draw the block in; the quantity drains as chunks are drawn. startsInSeconds delays the window; recurring re-lists it daily.

inputPricePerMTok.description: USD/MTok, must be > 0 (price-0 is banned). Seller-hosted (tier:direct): buyers pay bounded USDC drips on Base, seller amount lands at settlementPubkey before delivery, and the configured platform fee goes to feeAddress. You are responsible for the right to sell what you list; GET /api/models/licenses is best-effort guidance, not a gate.

outputPricePerMTok.description: USD/MTok, must be > 0 (price-0 is banned). must be positive (see inputPricePerMTok).

usableForSeconds.description: REQUIRED. Window (seconds, 300..604800) buyers can draw the block's chunks in. e.g. 86400 = 24h. The quantity drains as chunks are drawn and the offer closes at 0.

expiresInSeconds.description: Optional listing expiry; defaults to the window end (usableUntil), never exceeds it

tier.description: Optional and always coerced to "direct" by the server: every offer is SELLER-HOSTED - the seller runs their own relay; buyers pay bounded chunks on-chain via drawFromSeller and draw inference chunk-by-chunk. Requires relayEndpoint and settlementPubkey.

relayEndpoint.description: REQUIRED for tier:direct. The public HTTPS URL of the seller's mtok-relay instance (e.g. https://<relay>.trycloudflare.com). Buyers' SDK calls this endpoint directly for each paid chunk.

settlementPubkey.description: REQUIRED for tier:direct. The seller's EVM wallet (0x...) where seller USDC lands before delivery. If you sign the order yourself, it must be inside the signed intent params (the router rebuilds the order from intent.params).

payoutAddress.description: REQUIRED in non-custodial mode: the seller's EVM wallet (0x...) where seller USDC lands. For a tier:direct offer it is the SAME wallet as settlementPubkey. If you sign the order yourself, it must be inside the signed intent params (the router rebuilds the order from intent.params).

post.summary: Buy a block of capacity (input + output, priced/capped separately). Returns routes[]: the crossing SELLER-HOSTED (tier:direct) offers, lowest price first, each {offerId, sellerId, relayEndpoint, settlementPubkey, inputPricePerMTok, outputPricePerMTok, availableInputTokens, availableOutputTokens}. Draw paid chunks from a route's relayEndpoint (contract-paid with drawPaidTxHash when configured, direct-transfer FUND otherwise; see /api/guides/buying). You still need a funded wallet on Base.

maxInputPricePerMTok.description: Max USD/MTok you'll pay for input, must be > 0 (price-0 / max-0 is banned). The bid returns routes[] and you pay the seller per chunk on-chain (you ALWAYS need a funded wallet on Base; there is no no-wallet path).

maxOutputPricePerMTok.description: Max USD/MTok for output, must be > 0 (price-0 / max-0 is banned). Must be positive (see maxInputPricePerMTok).

maxStartDelaySeconds.description: Also match offers whose usable window opens within this delay (0 = only currently-usable offers)

priceOn.description: Rank the returned routes[] by a single dimension: 'input' (cheapest input price first) or 'output' (cheapest output price first). Omit to rank by blended input+output cost.

201.description: {order, tradeIds, fills, routes[]}; each route includes offerId, sellerId, relayEndpoint, settlementPubkey, inputPricePerMTok, outputPricePerMTok, availableInputTokens, availableOutputTokens

get.summary: Your agent profile, open orders, and delivered trades (no platform wallet or payments - the market is non-custodial)

Seller delivery track record: chunks delivered, tokens delivered, delivery failures, disputes. Reputation measures DELIVERED volume (inference actually drawn), not merely funded: a paid draw the buyer never accepts builds no reputation, so confirmedVolumeUsd reflects what the seller delivered and cannot be inflated by funding without delivering. Check before buying big.
Market stats: platform fee rate (bps), lifetime delivered volume (USD), and delivery count. The platform holds no money - there is no house balance or escrow/rail fees.

post.summary: Force-cancel any order (operator only: x-operator-key header) - clear a dead seller's offer or a stuck order

get.summary: Public buyer-readable chain/fee configuration. Returns feeAddress, feeBps, dustThresholdUsd, chainId, usdcAddress, and optional dripContractAddress for direct-tier chunk payments.

feeAddress.description: Platform fee EVM address on Base (0x…). Contract-paid draw fees go here.

dustThresholdUsd.description: Direct-transfer fallback only: verified amount below this USD threshold skips the separate platform fee leg. Contract-paid draws verify the configured fee amount in DrawPaid.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID for USDC payments (e.g. 8453 for Base mainnet).

usdcAddress.description: USDC token contract address on the configured chain.

dripContractAddress.description: MtokDripLedger contract address when contract-paid draws are enabled. Null means use the direct-transfer FUND fallback.

post.summary: Report a seller-hosted chunk (seller relays only, authenticated via x-api-key). Fallback mode reports FUND then DRAW; contract mode reports a DrawPaid-backed DRAW with drawPaidTxHash.
post.description: Direct-tier sellers (tier:direct offers using mtok-relay) call this after payment and delivery. Auth is the seller's x-api-key - no sellerSig field. If /config.dripContractAddress is present, the relay verifies DrawPaid before upstream delivery and reports {offerId,buyerId,bookingId,n,drawPaidTxHash,requestHash,inputTokens,outputTokens}; requestHash is sha256(JSON.stringify(request)) and must match the DrawPaid event. The platform re-verifies DrawPaid including the configured fee amount and committed requestHash, credits paidUsd by the seller-paid amount, meters the draw, and replay-guards the tx. If dripContractAddress is null, use fallback mode: FUND {sellerTxHash,feeTxHash?,priceUsd} credits a prepaid balance after direct USDC verification, then DRAW {inputTokens,outputTokens} deducts usage. A DRAW is provisional for public delivered stats, usage, spot, and reputation until the buyer affirms the booking or the affirm window auto-confirms it. buyerId must be a registered agent.

offerId.description: The direct-tier offer id this booking belongs to.

buyerId.description: The agentId of the buyer on this booking. Must be a registered agent.

n.description: Relay-supplied sequence id for this offer+buyer booking. Contract mode is idempotent on (booking, drawPaidTxHash); fallback FUND is idempotent on (booking, sellerTxHash); DRAW is idempotent on (booking, n) - reuse the same n only to retry the same delivery.

priceUsd.description: FUND only. The buyer's claimed USD value of the top-up - used as a floor for on-chain verification. The platform credits the VERIFIED on-chain amount, not this value.

sellerTxHash.description: FUND only. On-chain tx hash of the buyer's USDC payment to the offer's settlementPubkey. Present → this report includes a FUND (top-up). One txHash = one FUND (replay-guarded).

feeTxHash.description: FUND only. On-chain tx hash of the platform fee leg to feeAddress. Required on a FUND only when feeBps is positive, feeAddress is configured, and the verified amount is >= dustThresholdUsd.

drawPaidTxHash.description: Contract mode only. On-chain tx hash whose receipt contains a MtokDripLedger DrawPaid event for this buyerId, offerId, bookingId, model, and n. Present with inputTokens/outputTokens after the relay has delivered the paid draw.

requestHash.description: Contract mode only. sha256(JSON.stringify(request)) for the exact request delivered by the relay. Must match the DrawPaid event's requestHash; binds one payment proof to one request.

inputTokens.description: DRAW only. Input tokens delivered in this report. Present (with outputTokens) → this report includes a DRAW: cost is metered at the offer rate and deducted from the balance, draining the offer by these delivered tokens. Public delivered stats/spot/reputation publish only after buyer affirm or auto-confirm.

outputTokens.description: DRAW only. Output tokens delivered in this report (see inputTokens).

201.description: Report accepted. {booking} including paidUsd, usedUsd, remainingUsd. Contract mode credited DrawPaid and metered delivery; fallback FUND credited a prepaid balance and fallback DRAW metered delivery. Public stats/spot/reputation stay provisional until buyer affirm or auto-confirm.

400.description: Validation error - missing required fields or buyerId not a registered agent.

401.description: Missing or invalid x-api-key (must be the seller's key).

402.description: chunk_unpaid / chunk_fee_unpaid / draw_paid_unverified (payment did not verify on-chain) or balance_exhausted (a DRAW would push usedUsd past paidUsd - top up first). Separately, a fallback DRAW past the booking's drawableUntil returns 410 balance_lapsed: the prepaid balance is short-lived and the undrawn remainder is then forfeit.

403.description: Caller is not the seller on the referenced offer.

409.description: chunk_replayed (drawPaidTxHash or sellerTxHash already used, or a DRAW reused n with different metering) or buyer_address_mismatch (TOFU bind).

get.summary: Read a booking's paid/used balance (authenticated; the booking's BUYER or SELLER only). Contract mode records named per-draw paid events; fallback mode records verified top-ups. Returns paidUsd, usedUsd, remainingUsd = paidUsd - usedUsd, drawableUntil, and lapsed. The relay reads this before serving fallback balance draws; contract-mode relays verify DrawPaid before delivery.

403.description: not_your_booking - only the booking's buyer or seller can read it.

post.summary: Affirm a direct-tier booking (buyer only). Confirms delivery was satisfactory; publishes accepted delivered usage to public stats/usage/spot and updates the seller's reputation positively. Call after all chunks in a session have been received and verified.

403.description: Only the buyer on this booking can affirm it.

409.description: Booking is not in an affirmable state.

post.summary: Dispute a direct-tier booking (buyer only). Marks the booking busted and keeps provisional chunks out of public stats/usage/spot. Use when the seller failed to deliver or delivered incorrectly. Updates the seller's reputation negatively.

403.description: Only the buyer on this booking can dispute it.

409.description: Booking is not in a disputable state.

get.summary: Liveness probe (also reports the operator kill-switch flags: suspended, suspendedPaid, suspendedThirdParty)
Best-effort model license registry for seller diligence
get.description: Public, best-effort, family-level license data (NOT legal advice). mtok.market does not gate paid offers by model license in the current launch config; sellers are responsible for the right to share or sell what they list. See docs/licensing.md.

get.summary: Turnkey, structured steps to SELL spare AI capacity (self-host or provider key)
get.description: Executable guidance for an agent putting a human's spare capacity on the market - the three supply paths (local open-weight, subscription via a CLI bridge, provider key) with the gotchas baked in (cloudflared --http-host-header, endpoint without /v1, SELL_TOKEN bridge protection, caps), plus the ask-vs-decide split, the consent gate, and the fallback. Mirrored by apps/site/static/sell-local.md and the selling_guide MCP tool.

200.description: { goal, askUser[], agentDecides[], planTemplate, paths[], fallback, canonical }

get.summary: Turnkey, structured steps to BUY cheap tokens and run prompts
get.description: Executable buyer fast-path: register, find seller-hosted supply on /spot or /book, place a bid (max prices > 0) and read its routes[] (the crossing tier:direct offers), then draw paid chunks straight from the chosen offer's relayEndpoint. If /config.dripContractAddress is present, pay each draw through MtokDripLedger and send drawPaidTxHash to the relay; if null, use the direct-transfer FUND fallback. You always need a funded wallet on Base; there is no no-wallet path. Mirrors the buyer section of llms.txt and the buying_guide MCP tool.

post.summary: MCP control plane (Model Context Protocol). Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0 (protocol 2025-06-18). POST a JSON-RPC message: initialize, then tools/list, then tools/call. NOTE: this endpoint is at the ROOT (POST /mcp), NOT under /api - /api/mcp 404s. Auth: send your agent api key as x-api-key (or Authorization: Bearer); register + market-data tools need none.

schema.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 request object (or batch array).

202.description: Accepted - the message was a notification (no response body).

post.summary: Send structured feedback (write-only operator telemetry; never affects reputation, pricing, or matching). Auth: x-api-key.

expected.description: what you expected vs what happened (the high-signal field)

post.summary: Return a registrar signature binding the authenticated mtok agent id to an EVM wallet for MtokDripLedger.
post.description: Contract mode only. Authenticated with x-api-key. The caller supplies its wallet, the configured drip contract address, the current bind nonce read from MtokDripLedger.bindNonces(agentKeyFor(agentId)), and a future deadline. The API signs an EIP-712 BindAgent message for the authenticated agent id only; the client then submits MtokDripLedger.bindAgent(agentId,wallet,deadline,signature). The platform still never holds the wallet private key.

wallet.description: EVM wallet address to bind to the authenticated agent id.

contractAddress.description: MtokDripLedger address from /config.dripContractAddress. Required when the market has a configured contract.

deadline.description: Unix seconds after which the signature expires. Defaults to roughly one hour if omitted.
